flow.clone_without_hook: git clone → .git/hooks/pre-push absent (proven: clones don't inherit)
flow.import_self_heal: comms-sync import stamps hook + tracked copy, cmp-parity
flow.export_self_heal: hook deleted → export re-stamps BEFORE pushing, commits tracked copy if stale
flow.post_heal_guard: leaky commit via healed node → export refused (exit 1), remote tip unchanged
flow.bash32: same flow in container: B32_HEALED + PARITY_B32 + leak refused, raw in unit2-bash32.txt
